description: Bind <project> (owner/alias) to <account>. All subsequent commands scoped to that project resolve to <account>'s token, overriding the active account. Refuses if <account> has no token stored. Use to route different repos to different identities (work vs personal).

account.description: account name (must already exist via auth_login --as)

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

name: gitflic_auth_bind
